=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:784 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: PROMPT_PERSONA_PREFIX_ENABLED now defaults to "false", so callers that do not set it lose the persona prefix.
  WHY: This breaks the previously expected default behavior and the review-judge/prompt contract; all reviewers that raised it treated it as a blocker-level regression.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:411 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The orchestrate prompt-assembly staging loop omits _prelude_output_contract.txt.
  WHY: When the shared-prelude path is enabled, assembly fails because the required fragment is missing.
- tests/test_workflow_overlay_orchestrator.py:26-29 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test matches the for-loop as one verbatim substring instead of checking the required asset names individually.
  WHY: Cosmetic formatting or reordering changes in the workflow would cause false-negative CI failures even if runtime behavior is correct.
- tests/test_workflow_overlay_orchestrator.py:73-77 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts the entire multi-line loop verbatim, making it brittle to harmless whitespace or formatting changes.
  WHY: A cosmetic edit to the workflow staging loop would fail CI despite correct runtime behavior.
- tests/test_assemble_prompt.py:113-117 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The proc variable and assertions sit outside the TemporaryDirectory context manager.
  WHY: An exception inside the with block could turn the test into a NameError instead of a clear failure.
- scripts/assemble_prompt.sh:38-51 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The include-resolution logic does not guard against escaping prompts/ and reports a generic missing-fragment error.
  WHY: A malformed include can yield the wrong prompt content or an opaque failure message.
- agents.md:66-69 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The new note does not mention the default-off behavior and its implications.
  WHY: Readers may assume the shared-prelude path is active by default and miss why legacy bytes still emit.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: tests/test_assemble_prompt.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_assemble_prompt.py has test_assembled_templates_match_legacy_prompt_bytes(), but it sets PROMPT_PERSONA_PREFIX_ENABLED=false and does not assert the actual default-env-byte-stability path; no explicit regression test covers legacy bytes with default env var values.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_workflow_overlay_orchestrator.py:26-29 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test asserts the entire for-loop line as one verbatim substring rather than checking each required asset filename individually.
  WHY: A legitimate formatting or ordering change in the workflow would fail CI even though the staging loop still behaves correctly at runtime.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:784 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Phase-C persona-prefix default was flipped from "true" to "false".
  WHY: Callers that do not explicitly set the env var lose the prefix entirely, breaking the persona contract and review-judge paths that relied on the prefix by default.
- tests/test_assemble_prompt.py:113-117 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The proc variable and assertions are outside the with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(...) context manager block.
  WHY: If an exception occurs inside the with block before proc is assigned, the assertions can raise NameError and mask the real test failure.
- scripts/assemble_prompt.sh:38-51 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The include-resolution logic does not handle relative paths that escape the prompts/ directory, and the error message for missing fragments is generic.
  WHY: A malformed include can silently fall back to an incorrect file or emit a non-actionable error, leading to wrong prompt content with no clear diagnosis.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:784 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded default for PROMPT_PERSONA_PREFIX_ENABLED was flipped from "true" to "false".
  WHY: Workflows or consumers that do not explicitly set the environment variable will no longer get the Phase-C persona prefix, breaking backwards compatibility and persona-dependent prompts.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:411 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The three-file list in the orchestrate workflow assembly loop is a manual copy of files that must match the real on-disk assets.
  WHY: If any template file is renamed, deleted, or moved, the workflow will break in production runs with a non-obvious missing-file error.
- agents.md:66-69 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new note describes the shared-prelude refactor but does not mention the default-off behavior and its implications.
  WHY: Maintainers reading only agents.md will expect the new assembly path to be active by default and will not understand why legacy prompt bytes are still emitted.
- Requirement: "add byte-stability coverage"
  Expected change site: A regression test that asserts the assembled output bytes remain identical to legacy prompt bytes when PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=false.
  Evidence of absence: tests/test_assemble_prompt.py exercises the flag path and overlay assembly, but it does not include an explicit legacy-bytes regression test that would have caught the persona-prefix default flip.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

  WHY: Existing callers that depend on the prior default will now execute without the prefix, altering prompt output and potentially breaking review-judge paths that relied on the persona contract.

No test validates byte stability when using actual default environment variable values.

  Issue: Test uses brittle verbatim string matching for multi-line shell loop; whitespace or formatting changes cause false negatives
  Suggested minimal fix: Assert presence of individual required filenames rather than exact multi-line string match
  Estimated lines changed: 3
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

  PROBLEM: The test asserts that the entire multi-line for-loop string from ORCHESTRATE_PROMPT_ASSET_LOOP, including exact newline and spacing, is present verbatim in orchestrate.yml.

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- Requirement: "migrate the listed prompt templates onto the shared prelude, and add byte-stability coverage" (Phase O only, behind flag=false default).
  Expected change site: prompts/_prelude_*.txt + _templates/* + scripts/assemble_prompt.sh + comprehensive test asserting legacy bytes match exactly when flag=false.
  Evidence of absence: All required prelude fragments and templates are staged and the assembly test exists, but test_assemble_prompt.py does not assert PROMPT_PERSONA_PREFIX_ENABLED=false keeps the original legacy bytes; the persona-prefix change in render_prompt.py:784 therefore silently altered default output for callers that never set the variable.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/render_prompt.py:784 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Default changed from "true" to "false".
  WHY: Any workflow/job that does not explicitly export PROMPT_PERSONA_PREFIX_ENABLED=true now omits the Phase-C persona prefix that mode-judge-* and mode-review-* prompts relied on.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:411 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Staging loop for prompt_assembly_asset omitted _prelude_output_contract.txt.
  WHY: When PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=true, mode-orchestrate.txt and several judge templates include the fragment, so assembly fails with a missing-fragment error.
- scripts/assemble_prompt.sh:38-51 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: No guard against relative paths that escape prompts/ and only a generic not-found error for cyclic/missing include.
  WHY: A broken include produces an opaque error instead of a clear outside-prompts diagnostic, making assembly failures harder to debug.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
